items.title: Spin in focus as Bangladesh Test squad begin skill camp
items.summary: Bangladesh have had a pace challenge in Australia, and the UAE series would test batters skills against spin. It was no surprise that on day one, spin was on Tigers’ minds as they geared up for the Afghanistan challenge.

items.title: In Pictures: Tigers begins skill camp ahead of WTC marathon
items.summary: Bangladesh national cricketers hit the practice nets and consult with coaching staff as they kick off their intensive skill camp ahead of a grueling 50-day schedule featuring five Test matches.

items.title: ‘We are stuck’: Imran highlights crisis in Bangladesh women’s cricket
items.summary: He argued that international performance cannot be separated from the structure beneath the national team. While Sri Lanka has hundreds of girls participating in school cricket, Bangladesh does not have a comparable system, he said.

items.title: Fatima Sana and Umm-e-Hani secure bronze for Pakistan in Asian Games
items.summary: Bangladesh were in control of proceedings for the first half of Pakistan's innings, but lost their grip once Fatima Sana got going and never found it again

items.title: Bangladesh pick Hridoy for one-off Test against Afghanistan
items.summary: Nahid Rana and Taskin Ahmed were not available due to fitness and workload management issues

items.title: Dot balls the big concern as Bangladesh look to test favourites India
items.summary: India are the pre-eminent team in Asia and go into the Asian Games semi-finals just a week after winning the Asia Cup for a record eighth time

items.title: Charani, Shafali power India past Japan and into Asian Games semi-finals
items.summary: India set up semi-finals date with Bangladesh on September 20 for a spot in the gold-medal match
